title: US-short §8 单票再入场冷静期 (symbol re-entry cooldown) governance — const-pins the no-penalty-if-unfilled rule, the cooldown triggers, the in-cooldown action, and the anti-revenge-buy re-entry gate
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §8 symbol re-entry cooldown: a breakout order that did NOT fill never enters cooldown (没进场不罚); a filled position that then hits its stop, or a failed breakout, DOES enter cooldown; during cooldown the action is downgraded to observe; and full re-buy requires ALL of new catalyst + new structure + cooldown expired (防 revenge-buy). Cooldown length + recovery params are forward priors routed to §13.1 #23, not pinned. draft-07 cannot express: field byte-faithfulness, the all-required re-entry conjunction, provenance in §8, symbol_cooldown_status ∈ action_table columns, and param_calibration_item_id ∈ the lifecycle registry — enforced in tests.

breakout_unfilled_no_cooldown.description: §8 突破单未成交 = 不进冷静期（没进场不罚）— not entering is never penalized.

enters_cooldown_on.description: §8 + §18.1 #16 conditions that DO enter cooldown — BOTH require a prior fill (成交后失败才进): a filled position that then stop-losses, or a FILLED breakout that then fails. An unfilled breakout never enters cooldown, so every trigger here is a filled_then_* event.

during_cooldown_action.description: §8 期内动作降观察 — actions during cooldown are downgraded to observe.

reentry_requires.description: §8 full re-buy requires ALL of these (anti-revenge-buy conjunction).

reentry_all_required.description: §8 新催化剂 + 新结构 + 期满 — all three are jointly required (AND, not any-of).

param_calibration_item_id.description: §8 冷静期长度 + 恢复条件 = prior → §13.1 #23.
